author: kirubaharan181
description: Plans and runs risk-based testing and defect handling. Use when verifying behavior before release. Do NOT use for fixing defects or security scans.
purpose: Gives release decision makers honest, reproducible evidence of quality: test strategy and plans, test execution at every level, performance testing, defect management and sign-off. It owns stages 77-97.
when_to_use: A test strategy or plan is needed for a release.
Functional, regression, performance or compatibility testing must be run and reported.
Defects need triage and a sign-off statement.
when_not_to_use: Vulnerability scanning and threat modeling: use application-security.
prerequisites: Testable acceptance criteria and a risk list.
A test environment with test data and a known build.
Access to the build identifier under test.
No external API keys, paid services or network access are required; work uses files and tools already approved in the repository.
outputs: test plan with measurable exit criteria

decision_rules.situation: Results are from a different build
decision_rules.action: Rerun on the release candidate before sign-off.
Fix or quarantine it; never report it as PASS.
Report not met; a waiver needs a named owner and expiry.
List it explicitly in the sign-off.

quality_gates: Exit criteria are measurable and each has a result
Results name build, environment and data

examples.title: Write exit criteria
examples.request: Draft exit criteria for the payments release.
examples.context: High-risk flows: refunds and card changes.
examples.behavior: Trace each high risk to planned tests and define measurable criteria.
examples.output: Exit criteria: no open critical defects, all high-risk flows automated and passing, load test at 1.5 times peak.
examples.acceptance: Every high risk maps to at least one test.

examples.title: Report test status
examples.context: Load test ran at 1.2 times peak against a 1.5 target.
examples.behavior: Compare results with each criterion, mark the load criterion not met and list the residual risk.
examples.output: Scorecard: 7 of 8 criteria met; recommendation: release with a condition and a retest date.
examples.acceptance: Not-met criterion and its owner are stated.

limitations: Test results describe only the tested build, data and environment.
Cannot run tests that require unavailable environments; it records them as BLOCKED.
Sign-off is a recommendation; a named human decides release.

troubleshooting.resolution: Record BLOCKED, do not substitute results from another environment.
Isolate data and rerun with the recorded reason.

handoffs.artifact: test sign-off with exit criteria scorecard
